title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.

job context

and purpose

Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

job

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account’s objectives and the client’s initiatives.

  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.

title: E-commerce Operations Specialist
description:
E-commerce Operations Specialist (Mid to Senior Level) – Bilingual (EN)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

About Transsion

Transsion is a globally recognized mobile technology company, delivering innovative, high-quality, and affordable devices through our trusted brands: itel, TECNO, and Infinix. We serve dynamic and fast-growing markets, offering breakthrough value and performance across diverse consumer needs.

Role Overview

We’re seeking an experienced E-commerce Operations Specialist to lead and scale the operational backbone of itel’s online retail presence. This mid to senior-level role is ideal for a results-driven professional with proven expertise in e-commerce fulfillment, cross-functional coordination, and digital process optimization. You’ll be responsible for streamlining end-to-end platform operations, elevating customer satisfaction, and ensuring that every transaction supports brand growth and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee day-to-day operations of multiple e-commerce platforms, ensuring accuracy in inventory, smooth order fulfillment, and efficient payment processing.

• Lead coordination across marketing, sales, logistics, and customer service teams to execute online campaigns, promotions, and seasonal events.

• Maintain and continuously optimize product listings, content, and digital assets to align with brand goals and drive conversion.

• Monitor stock movements across digital channels, implement replenishment alerts, and reduce risks of stockouts or overstock.

• Develop operational SOPs to scale post-purchase processes and maximize efficiency.

• Track and report on key operational metrics: order accuracy, return rates, customer satisfaction, and service SLAs.

• Proactively manage escalations related to payment issues, delivery discrepancies, or customer feedback.

• Identify workflow bottlenecks and apply process automation tools where possible.

• Partner with regional teams to ensure local compliance, payment reconciliation, and logistics alignment.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Logistics, or related field.

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in e-commerce operations or retail fulfillment; preferably in mobile tech, consumer electronics, or FMCG.

• Professional fluency in English (mandatory); additional languages are a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to lead operational initiatives and drive performance improvements across teams.

• Strong command of digital commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, or regional equivalents).

• High attention to detail and familiarity with supply chain and payment systems.

• Strong analytical mindset and experience interpreting operational data and customer insights.

• Passion for innovation, digital commerce, and emerging tech markets.

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Job Title: Data Quality Analyst

Purpose:

The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for auditing and testing enterprise applications with a focus on backend ETL (Extract, Transform & Load) processes and other software modules related to the creation of data warehouse reporting instruments , ensuring high-quality and reliable information. This role also involves creating ad-hoc queries to extract information from reporting sources as requested by business areas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow established quality assurance standards and processes .
  • Determine and implement methods, flows, and procedures to improve QA and business processes.
  • Create and document test scripts to audit data integrity on an ongoing basis.
  • Test newly developed applications by creating test scenarios and verifying compliance with business requirements.
  • Analyze and resolve application and data issues as they arise.
  • Document production processes and objects for better understanding across IT and business users.
  • Handle ad-hoc data warehouse queries for end users as needed.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related business discipline from an accredited institution; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Data Quality Assurance , preferably in data warehousing or reporting environments .
  • At least 2 years of QA testing experience , ideally in data integrity assessment .
  • Preferably 2+ years of experience in the travel industry .
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

Technical Skills:

  • SQL and PL/SQL (Oracle platform preferred).
  • Strong understanding of ETL processes (Extract, Transform, Load).
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and architectures.
  • Experience creating and executing test scripts for data validation.
  • Strong data analysis and troubleshooting skills with large datasets.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (tables, indexes, triggers, etc.).
  • Familiarity with reporting/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, OBIEE, Cognos).
  • Intermediate English level (B2) – strong written and verbal communication required.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in team environments .
  • Capable of managing multiple projects and shifting priorities effectively.

Benefits:

  • Career development plan and continuous training opportunities.
  • Excellent work environment with flexibility.
  • Direct benefits from the client.
  • 100% remote work , or hybrid mode if you are based in Medellín.
  • A workplace where professional growth meets quality of life .
  • More than just a job offer – this is a life experience where you can grow professionally while enjoying a flexible, dynamic, and challenging environment .

title: Supervisor de manutenção predial
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO:

Supervisiona e realiza trabalhos técnicos e mecânicos que garantem que os ambientes internos e externos dos prédios, terrenos, áreas comuns e comodidades da comunidade atendam aos padrões da Empresa em relação à limpeza, aparência, segurança e funcionalidade geral.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Auxilia e executa ordens de serviço geradas por solicitações dos moradores, bem como manutenção de rotina na comunidade, diagnosticando a origem ou causa do defeito ou problema e realizando os reparos de acordo com as políticas, procedimentos, normas de segurança e exigências do código estabelecidos.

• Supervisiona e conclui o processo de preparação (“make-ready”) das unidades desocupadas para locação e novos moradores, realizando a inspeção pré-desocupação, criando uma lista de manutenção necessária, agendando fornecedores e prestadores de serviço conforme necessário, adquirindo os materiais e suprimentos necessários, realizando todas as tarefas de manutenção e inspecionando o trabalho concluído.

• Desenvolve padrões para a limpeza e aparência geral das áreas externas da comunidade, comodidades, fachadas dos edifícios, interiores das unidades prontas para locação, corredores, calçadas, placas, escritório de locação, áreas centrais de lixo, estacionamentos e outras construções e áreas comuns, garantindo que reflitam a alta qualidade da comunidade e os padrões da Greystar.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por outros membros da equipe de manutenção para avaliar a eficácia das políticas e procedimentos e desenvolver planos de ação corretiva conforme necessário.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por empreiteiros, fornecedores e outros prestadores de serviços para verificar se os serviços, materiais e mão de obra atendem aos padrões de qualidade, escopo e especificações exigidas.

• Mantém inventário adequado de peças de reposição e materiais de manutenção, trabalhando com o Gerente da Comunidade para encomendar suprimentos e ferramentas conforme necessário, respeitando os limites orçamentários.

• Executa os procedimentos de manutenção preventiva mensalmente conforme descrito no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoia programas de economia e controle de despesas consertando, sempre que possível, ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdício de materiais e suprimentos e utilizando ferramentas e equipamentos corretamente.

• Realiza reuniões regulares de segurança da Greystar, garante que todas as fichas MSDS estejam atualizadas e acessíveis, e mantém-se informado sobre todas as exigências e legislações de segurança da OSHA e outras entidades para garantir a conformidade da comunidade.

CONHECIMENTOS BÁSICOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem fornecer suas próprias ferramentas manuais, salvo quando proibido pela legislação estadual, e devem ter conhecimento e habilidades no uso e manutenção seguros de ferramentas manuais, elétricas, equipamentos mecânicos e dispositivos de medição.

• Capacidade demonstrada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para definir e corrigir problemas.

• Proficiência em atendimento ao cliente e habilidades de comunicação interpessoal para interagir eficazmente com moradores, clientes, colegas de equipe e outros contatos profissionais, respondendo com cortesia a perguntas e solicitações e mantendo a calma ao lidar com problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz para representar a gestão da empresa em funções de apoio, atuar como primeiro ponto de contato para colegas de equipe internos e visitantes externos, e responder a perguntas relacionadas às políticas operacionais do departamento.

• Proficiência demonstrada em programas de internet, processamento de texto, planilhas e gerenciamento de banco de dados para manter registros e desenvolver informações para uso do gestor. (Experiência com sistemas de gestão imobiliária é preferida.)

• Capacidade de operar máquinas básicas de escritório, como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de selos postais e sistemas telefônicos com várias linhas.

• Habilidades matemáticas necessárias para somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir números, decimais e frações para revisar e preencher documentos financeiros, administrativos e legais.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.

LICENÇAS OU CERTIFICAÇÕES EXIGIDAS:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem possuir todas as certificações exigidas pelas jurisdições estaduais e locais.

VIAGENS / EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Os membros da equipe trabalham em ambiente de escritório ou remoto. Nenhuma exigência física especial é necessária.

• Viagens raras ou ocasionais podem ser exigidas para participar de reuniões de negócios, treinamentos ou outras situações necessárias para o cumprimento de algumas ou todas as responsabilidades diárias deste cargo.

Sobre a Greystar

A Greystar é uma empresa global líder, totalmente integrada, do setor imobiliário, oferecendo expertise em gestão de propriedades, gestão de investimentos, desenvolvimento e serviços de construção nos setores de habitação para locação de padrão institucional, logística e ciências da vida. Com sede em Charleston, Carolina do Sul, a Greystar gerencia e opera mais de US$ 290 bilhões em imóveis em 247 mercados globalmente, com escritórios em toda a América do Norte, Europa, América do Sul e região da Ásia-Pacífico. A Greystar é a maior operadora de apartamentos nos Estados Unidos, administra mais de 857.400 unidades/leitos em todo o mundo e possui uma robusta plataforma institucional de gestão de investimentos, com mais de US$ 76 bilhões em ativos sob gestão, incluindo mais de US$ 34 bilhões em ativos em desenvolvimento. A Greystar foi fundada por Bob Faith em 1993 com o objetivo de se tornar uma prestadora de serviços de classe mundial no setor imobiliário residencial para locação. Para saber mais, acesse .

Deployment & Operations

  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)

Plus/Nice to Have

description:
Responsibilities:

Atuação temporária (projeto com duração de 1 ano) na Torre de Master Data, no contexto da implantação do SAP S/4HANA. Responsável por apoiar o saneamento, padronização e estruturação dos dados mestres de materiais atualmente mantidos no SAP ECC, garantindo qualidade e integridade dos dados para a migração ao novo sistema.

ATIVIDADES

  • Liderar iniciativas de padronização de descrições, atributos técnicos e taxonomias conforme as diretrizes do projeto de Master Data;

REQUISITOS

  • Formação Superior;
  • Conhecimento técnico em materiais industriais (mecânicos, elétricos, hidráulicos, automação e instrumentação etc.);
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos;
  • Experiência sólida com cadastro e manutenção de materiais e fornecedores no SAP ECC e S/4 Hana (módulo MM);
  • Experiência com governança de dados mestres e/ou plataforma de gestão de dados mestres como WebforMat e Astrein;
  • Familiaridade com a plataforma SAP Ariba, especialmente nos processos de cadastro e homologação de fornecedores;
  • Perfil analítico, com atenção a detalhes, organização e visão crítica.
  • Capacidade de criar RPA, Scripts nos Microsoft Excel.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Participação prévia em projetos de implantação de SAP S/4HANA;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em taxonomias e classificação de materiais (UNSPSC, NCM, eClass, etc.);
  • Experiência com processos de Master Data Management (MDM) e governança de dados mestres;
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas aplicáveis (ABNT, ISO, ASTM, DIN);
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica, atuação transversal e visão orientada à qualidade de dados.

title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN:

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Senior Support Specialist to provide advanced technical support for users and systems within a corporate IT environment. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID (Azure AD), and user support through ticketing systems. This professional will also handle basic Windows and Linux server maintenance and perform network troubleshooting as needed. The role involves ensuring service stability, maintaining system integrity, and collaborating with infrastructure and security teams to improve operational efficiency and end-user experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for users, resolving incidents and service requests via the ticketing system.
  • Administer and maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Intune.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, and access permissions in Entra ID (Azure Active Directory). Perform basic maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Windows and Linux servers. Support network-related issues such as connectivity, DHCP, DNS, and VPN access.
  • Document technical procedures, configurations, and solutions. Collaborate with other IT teams on escalations, system improvements

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Proven experience in IT support, preferably in corporate or enterprise environments. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Entra ID (Azure AD). Basic understanding of Windows Server and Linux environments.

title: Especialista Controladoria Logística (Finance)
description:
About Us:

CNH Industrial is a world-class equipment and services company dedicated to advancing the noble work of agriculture and construction workers. Driven by our shared purpose of Breaking New Ground, we are passionate about bringing Innovation, Sustainability, and Productivity to all that we do. As a truly global company, CNH Industrial’s 37,000+ employees form part of a diverse and inclusive workplace, focused on empowering customers to grow, and build, a better world through our core brands: Case IH, STEYR, New Holland Agriculture, CASE, and New Holland Construction.

In Precision Technology, we make iron smarter. Our team members deliver innovative solutions helping our customers to be more productive, save time, lower costs, and to operate sustainably. From vehicle displays, application controls, steering solutions, digital services, and telematics, to fully autonomous driverless technology, we develop solutions that solve challenges for customers around the world.

#GrowACareer.

#BuildAFuture.

Atividades Inbound

  • Gestão de provisões (accruals) de frete inbound, assegurando correto reconhecimento contábil e compliance com auditoria.
  • Controle de custos de transporte inbound (rodoviário, marítimo, aéreo e serviços logísticos)
  • Gestão financeira do WMF Brasil, incluindo controle de despesas logísticas, alocação por centro de lucro e acompanhamento das movimentações entre plantas e o 3PL.
  • Controle e atualização de custos std (standard cost) de transporte inbound, garantindo que cada item consumido tenha o frete std corretamente atrelado e que as variações (real vs. std) sejam explicadas e reportadas.
  • Análise de variações (budget vs. forecast vs. real) para identificar desvios de frete spot, demurrage, escolta, armazenagem e propor planos de ação junto ao time de operações.
  • Elaboração de relatórios para liderança (MOR, Forecast Reviews, CFO updates), traduzindo os impactos logísticos em indicadores financeiros claros.
  • Interface com áreas globais e locais (Operações, Contratos, Fiscal/Tax, Tesouraria e Engenharia) para garantir aderência a normas contábeis, regulatórias e compliance (incluindo SOX).
  • Análise de impactos de tarifas, impostos e regulações aduaneiras (Recof, Ex-Tarifário, alterações de Incoterm), consolidando ganhos e perdas no resultado.
  • Suporte em BID/RFQ de transportadoras, avaliando cenários financeiros, savings potenciais e impactos no budget/forecast.
  • Monitoramento de KPIs financeiros logísticos, como custo por tonelada/km, saturação de caminhões, waiting hours e demurrage, consolidando dashboards para decisão.

Requisitos:

Superior completo.

Experiência em finanças e controladoria, com sólidos conhecimentos contábeis.

Experiência com melhoria de processos e implementação de melhores práticas.

Experiência em suporte a auditorias e garantia de conformidade com a SOX e controles internos.

Experiência em ambientes multinacionais, com relatórios e colaboração entre equipes globais.

Experiência prática com análise financeira, previsão e planejamento estratégico (FP&A).

Experiência prévia com estruturas de custos e impactos financeiros de transporte/logística de entrada (preferencial).

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI

Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Analista DevOps Sênior — AWS | IaC | SRE
description:
Analista DevOps Sênior — AWS | IaC | SRE

Híbrido – Nova Lima (MG)

Buscamos uma pessoa DevOps para sustentar, automatizar e evoluir nossa infraestrutura cloud em ambiente altamente transacional . Se você domina AWS , IaC , CI/CD e práticas de SRE/observabilidade , aqui é o lugar para elevar confiabilidade, segurança e performance — com automação como regra.

Missão

  • Criar pipelines e orquestrações eficientes, com segurança de ponta a ponta , garantindo disponibilidade, resiliência e desempenho dos serviços.

title: CONSULTOR(A) CIENTISTA DADOS II
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

DADOS:

GS: 17

Local: Jacareí / SP (Hibrido)

Inscrições até: 06/11/2025

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Criar modelos e ensembles de modelos usando técnicas combinadas de Machine Learning, estatística e otimização para solução de problemas de negócio;
  • Criar ferramentas com o foco no aumento da produtividade do time em atividades críticas de Machine Learning, como pré-processamento, criação dos modelos e deploy;
  • Interpretar resultados e gerar visualizações e conclusões de análises que construam histórias relevantes e conjunto de ações para a organização;
  • Construir forte relacionamento com diversas áreas internas a empresa de modo a garantir entendimento compreensivo dos requisitos do negócio;
  • Trabalhar em modelo ágil e de forma colaborativa dentro de squads;
  • Orientar o time com metodologia, ferramenta e conhecimento para soluções de problemas com Machine Learning;
  • Definir melhores práticas de Gestão de Dados e Gestão do Código para garantindo pontualidade e rigor nas soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Fazer a conexão entre problemas de negócio e oportunidades analíticas, sendo capaz de estimar benefícios para o negócio;
  • Ser capaz de comunicar de forma profissional e objetivo os benefícios e alavancas dos produtos digitais para especialistas do negócio em vários níveis de senioridade;
  • Liderar tecnicamente um dos domínios de ciência de dados (Otimização, Visão Computacional, NLP, etc) entre as tribos, definindo requisitos, tecnologias e melhores práticas;
  • Construir e gerenciar análises de múltiplas bases de dados de grande volume (ex. base de transações, vendedores, clientes) usando diversas ferramentas técnicas (SQL, R, Python, Excel) para criar análises fundadas com qualidade e rigor;
  • Desenvolver modelos de otimização linear inteira, inteira mista, algoritmos evolutivos modelos utilizando técnicas de Inteligência Artificial para solução de problemas de negócio;
  • Definir o frame do problema, suas features e a melhor forma de criar modelos para soluções de problemas;
  • Criar modelos na forma de micro serviços ou APIs em serviços de cloud ou on-premise;
  • Definir junto com times de TI requisitos de Arquitetura, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir robustez e automação nas soluções desenvolvidas.

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Ensino Superior Completo em áreas STEM (estatística, tecnologia, engenharias ou matemática);
  • Sólida experiencia na área de ciência de dados – Modelagem e/ou projetos de otimização;
  • Experiencia com métodos analíticos avançados (ex. Machine Learning/ Deep Learning / Otimização, entre outros);
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias e linguagens de programação como Python, R e SQL;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura e serviços de cloud, como: Containers, Virtural Machines, bancos de dados no-sql, integração;
  • Experiência em programação e uso de linguagem como Python e/ou R Experiência em ferramentas de programação como Python para publicar modelos na forma de micro serviços ou APIs seja na nuvem ou on-premises;
  • Experiência no uso em ferramentas de colaboração e versionamento de códigos;
  • Experiência em esteiras de CI/CD (Azure pipelines, Github Actions, etc);
  • Experiência em modelos de otimização exatos e/ou heurísticas na solução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento técnico: estatística avançada e análises e conceitos financeiros avançados;
  • Cinco anos de experiência de trabalho com análises, modelagem preditiva e interpretação de dados ou similares na área;
  • Será feito um teste na forma de case ou prova online para que o candidato demonstre habilidades na área
  • Vivencia no segmento industrial será considerado um diferencial;
  • Desejável especialização ou pós graduação na área de machine learning, estatística ou pesquisa operacional;
  • Desejável Dois ou mais anos de experiência em Consultoria Estratégica e/ou Serviços Financeiros;
  • Desejável inglês avançado.

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;

  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on-line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.

title: Technical Sales Manager (Master Brewer)
description:
About the role

The Brewing Specialist will lead technical and customer-driven initiatives to support innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings in the alcoholic beverage sector, with a strong focus on beer brewing. This role is responsible for building strategic client relationships, driving adoption of Kerry technologies, and aligning with cross-functional teams to deliver excellence across LATAM.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead with technical insights and leverage customer/consumer feedback to drive innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings.
  • Align with the RDA (Research, Development & Applications) team to ensure cross-functional excellence and consistent ways of working.
  • Own and manage the overall relationship with assigned clients, including onboarding, implementation, and increasing adoption of Kerry technologies.
  • Establish a high level of customer intimacy and build trusted, strategic relationships to drive continued value.
  • Develop and maintain customer success strategies and share best practices across commercial teams.
  • Ensure alignment with Kerry’s alcoholic beverage strategy in LATAM, with a specific focus on beer brewing.
  • Travel to client sites across LATAM at least 70% of the time to support implementation, relationship building, and technical collaboration.

Qualifications and skills

  • Degree in Brewing Science, Fermentation Science, Food Science, or a related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a commercial brewing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of brewing equipment, ingredients, and techniques.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance and laboratory testing procedures.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required.
  • Strong communication, strategic planning, and project management skills.
  • Analytical and process-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working across multiple departments in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Active team player, self-starter, and multitasker with the ability to quickly adjust priorities.
  • Passion for craft beer and innovation.
  • Skilled at developing and delivering compelling stories to clients and stakeholders.
  • Certification from recognized brewing institutions (e.g., Cicerone, IBD) (Desirable)
  • Experience with sustainable brewing practices (Desirable)
  • Knowledge of local and international beer styles (Desirable)

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

Asendia AI is a fast-growing B2B SaaS startup redefining how staffing agencies source, screen, and hire candidates, powered by voice AI, automation, and agentic workflows.

Who You Are

  • Product-minded engineer. You care about users and outcomes, not just code.

  • What’s In It For You Take ownership of building a billion-dollar product from the ground up.

  • Ship fast, see your impact directly in production and customer success.
  • Competitive salary

title: Senior Asset & Material Management Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Responsible for the end-to-end management of company assets and materials, including inventory control, maintenance, recycling, disposal, and system operations, ensuring asset security, compliance, and efficient utilization.

Job Responsibilities:

  1. Manage the inbound and outbound flow of materials; verify that material name codes, quantities, and specifications match system records and purchase orders; establish asset cards in a timely manner to ensure alignment between physical items, records, and system entries.
  2. Review and oversee the recycling of materials and the optimal allocation of idle resources.
  3. Track material maintenance activities, assign maintenance personnel, monitor maintenance progress, and collect and analyze maintenance data.
  4. Review and handle scrapped materials and commodities according to company procedures; ensure proper disposal of such items.
  5. Provide guidance and supervision on departmental material and asset management; ensure the implementation of asset management responsibilities at the individual level; manage recovery and compensation in cases of material damage or loss.

Requirements:

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above; at least 5 years of experience in asset management or administrative management is preferred.
  2. Familiar with asset management processes; proficient in asset management systems and computer operations, especially MS Office (Word, Excel, etc.).
  3. Solid knowledge of asset management, including asset definition, classification, management methods, and understanding of the asset lifecycle concept.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Business Operations Associate

payment methods to our subacquirer, helping businesses increase transaction approvals and improve

partner for companies looking to expand efficiently, offering technology and personalized support in an

all-in-one platform.

We are looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our dynamic team.

You will have the opportunity to drive the success of businesses in Brazil and play a critical role in

relationships with our clients. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and driven by

problem-solving. Our operations and customer success teams are the tip of the spear of our business,

with agile thinking and excellent communication to drive positive change for our customers.

information.

purposes.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to payment

operations.

  • Track and report customer success metrics, including satisfaction rates, retention, and churn.

Nice to haves:

  • You communicate clearly and concisely
  • You can adapt and explain complex subjects to different audiences

Sua missão será conectar estratégia, dados e usabilidade para desenhar produtos digitais que gerem impacto real para o negócio e para as pessoas.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.

This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.

We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .

What you will do:

  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.

What we expect from you:

  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.

What We Offer

  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You’ll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based ( fully remote )

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours

What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

How to Apply

Submit your CV  in English , and  one paragraph describing how you would approach the  first 60 days after a new client’s go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Strategic Projects Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.

We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

Vammo is hiring a strategic, high-performing leader to join our Special Projects & Strategy team - a small, elite group working directly with executives and founders - to solve the most complex and high-impact challenges in the company. You’ll drive cross-functional initiatives that shape Vammo’s growth trajectory - from fleet and asset optimization to financial modeling, new business models, partnerships, and operational scaling.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, loves tackling hard problems, and moves seamlessly between data, strategy, and execution. You will be deeply embedded across teams - working hand-in-hand with Fleet, Charging, Maintenance, Sales, Software, and Hardware - and expected to think like an owner.

You will be based in São Paulo and will report directly to executives at Vammo

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute high-impact strategic projects that directly influence Vammo’s operational and financial performance.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and drive implementation.
  • Build analytical frameworks and dashboards to inform decision-making across the company.
  • Develop business cases, models, and strategic plans for new initiatives — from asset financing structures to expansion playbooks.
  • Own key cross-functional workstreams (e.g., pricing, network expansion, strategic partnerships).
  • Translate insights into clear recommendations and operational action.
  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team on fundraising, board materials, and strategic communications.
  • Build and mentor small, high-performing project teams as the function scales.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of total experience, ideally including:

2–4 years at a top-tier management consulting firm (BCG, Bain, McKinsey, etc.)

3–4 years in a high-growth startup or operating role where you owned key projects end-to-end.

  • Proven track record of leading and executing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills — comfortable in Excel, PowerPoint, and with messy data.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly, and move fast.
  • Strong business judgment and curiosity about how hardware, logistics, and software intersect.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish or Chinese a plus.
  • Based in São Paulo, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Strong alignment with Vammo’s mission and values.

Benefits

  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America’s most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Exposure to all areas of the business — you’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team on company-defining decisions.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other protected factor.

Munksjö is a leading international manufacturer of decor paper for surface finishing on wood-based panels.

Our mission is to create comfortable living and working environments , always driven by innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility .

We develop and deliver innovative and customized decorative paper solutions , which, after further processing, are used in the production of furniture, laminate flooring, and surface materials for both indoor and outdoor applications.

At Munksjö, we believe that taking responsibility for the future of our planet is a priority — sustainability is at the core of everything we do.

About the Role

We are seeking a QHSE Coordinator with proven focus on environmental management to join our team in Caieiras-SP.

This professional will be responsible for ensuring the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of QHSE systems and practices, with a strong emphasis on environmental compliance and performance .

The role plays a key part in promoting a sustainability-driven culture , ensuring alignment with environmental legislation, corporate goals, and best practices .

Responsibilities

Environmental Management

  • Plan, implement, and monitor sustainability and environmental management programs.
  • Track and analyze environmental KPIs (emissions, effluents, waste, energy, and water consumption).
  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and licenses.
  • Conduct and manage internal and external audits.
  • Lead environmental impact mitigation and carbon neutrality projects.
  • Develop environmental awareness and engagement campaigns.
  • Oversee supplier and partner compliance with environmental requirements.
  • Lead strategic environmental initiatives (e.g., zero landfill, waste segregation).
  • Support occupational health and safety programs and accident prevention initiatives.
  • Monitor HSE indicators and propose corrective/preventive actions.
  • Maintain and enhance the Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Coordinate QHSE training and awareness activities.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and zero accidents.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Degree in Environmental Engineering, Production Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree in Environmental Management, Sustainability, or related areas (preferred).
  • Fluent English (mandatory).

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in QHSE, with proven focus on environmental management.
  • Experience in multinational organizations, interacting with corporate and external stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of leading environmental projects.

Technical Knowledge:

  • Brazilian environmental legislation.
  • Waste, effluent, and emission management.
  • Continuous improvement and risk analysis tools.
  • Environmental and sustainability performance indicators (ESG).
  • Understanding of GHG Scopes 1, 2, and 3.

Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.

Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.

title: Senior Consultant - Treasury (Brazil)
description:
Senior Consultant - Treasury, Financial Transactions & Accounting

Fully remote position offering a flexible work schedule.

Location: LATAM (Brazil)

You’ll work with top-tier clients across industries - multinationals, banks, and government entities. You're not just executing tasks, you’re leading workstreams, shaping recommendations, and driving change in treasury organizations.

About us:

Founded in 2003 by Chad Wekelo, Actualize Consulting emerged from a vision to create a niche firm where every team member is valued as a collaborator rather than just an employee. Drawing from his Big Four experience, Chad, alongside partners Matt Seu and COO, Kerry Wekelo; built a company specializing in Capital Markets, Mortgage and Fixed Income, and Treasury Operations. Their leadership fostered a culture rooted in gratitude, trust, and growth. Kerry's personal journey led to the development of wellness-based principles that transformed the company's culture. This commitment to employee well being and mutual respect has earned Actualize numerous accolades, including recognition as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and Great Place to Work Certified. Beyond internal culture, Actualize is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and community impact, and a belief that a people-first approach drives both personal fulfillment and professional excellence.

Job description:

We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in financial transactions, treasury management systems, and accounting advisory. In this role, you will advise clients on optimizing their treasury operations, cash management, and transaction accounting processes, while ensuring compliance with IFRS/US GAAP and best practices. You will work closely with CFOs, Treasurers, and finance teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from system implementation and integration to technical accounting guidance for complex treasury transactions.

Required Skills:

• Lead client engagements focused on treasury management systems (TMS) implementation, configuration, and optimization

• Advise on accounting treatment for cash, liquidity, hedging, financial instruments, and intercompany transactions.

• Support clients with treasury transformation projects, including process automation and system enhancements.

• Provide technical expertise on treasury-related accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated consulting solutions.

• Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.

Desired Skills:

• Experience in financial services or corporate treasury environment

• Solid analytical and quantitative skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with financial modeling is a plus.

• System/software implementation experience

• Exposure to financial instruments including derivatives, funding, and investments

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting

CFA, CPA, or CTP certification is preferred

English: Able to communicate fluently, you will work with a multicultural team and consultants from other countries.

Contact/application information:

Please submit your resume to . If accepted, we’ll be in touch to schedule an interview. 

Thank you!

title: Supervisor de Instalações Industriais

Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira que nasceu da vontade e do esforço de empreendedores em inovar de forma sustentável, valorizando a vida e oferecendo produtos e serviços que aquecem, alimentam e movem o país inteiro. title: ESPECIALISTA DE TRANSFORMAÇÃO
description:

Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

Como será seu dia a dia?

O Transformation Office é responsável por conectar a Estratégia à Estrutura Organizacional e aos processos da empresa, garantindo coesão entre Governança, Papéis e Responsabilidades. Possui o mandato de acelerar as transformações organizacionais, aproveitando sua visão transversal da companhia para fortalecer a conexão entre as capacidades de negócios e seus diferenciais competitivos.

O Especialista de Transformação atua como agente acelerador de transformações em um negócio específico, assegurando o desdobramento da Estratégia em iniciativas, identificando sinergias com outras áreas e negócios, além de destravar bloqueios e construir pontes entre diferentes estruturas da companhia visando alcançar os objetivos estratégicos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir ritos e mediar discussões envolvendo stakeholders das diferentes áreas da companhia;

  • Acompanhar a gestão de portfólio de iniciativas das áreas/negócios que atua
  • Participar de ritos e suportar os líderes das áreas de negócio para evoluir nas práticas de gestão propostas pelo Transformation Office;
  • Identificar oportunidades de sinergia com os demais Especialistas de Transformação e propor soluções para que os benefícios identificados sejam capturados entre áreas/negócios;
  • Conduzir iniciativas cross que estejam relacionadas com o escopo da diretoria;
  • Contribuir com a construção, condução e implementação de melhorias, processos e métodos de gestão organizacional e desdobramento de estratégia;
  • Adaptar-se rapidamente a novas demandas e mudanças no ambiente corporativo, promovendo uma abordagem flexível e ágil.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excel avançado (não necessário VBA);
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos ou PMO, voltados à transformação.
  • Experiência com construção e condução de apresentações: apresentando familiaridade com storytelling, independente de qual ferramenta será utilizada;
  • Construção e análise de dados, conhecimento de Power BI para elaboração de relatórios;
  • Comunicação eficaz;
  • Foco em resultado.

Diferencial:

  • Formação: Engenharias, Administração, Ciências exatas, Economia (preferencial)
  • Experiência em consultoria estratégica ou de gestão
  • Pós graduação em áreas correlatas com o desafio.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.

Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java , que trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as equipes internas e os clientes para compreender e analisar as necessidades do projeto. Seu dia a dia envolverá a implementação de soluções baseadas na linguagem Java, utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas apropriadas para atender aos requisitos e garantir a qualidade do código.

Este profissional estará envolvido(a) no processo de desenvolvimento completo, desde o planejamento e a análise até a programação, testes e implantação. Sua participação ativa em reuniões de equipe e revisões de código ajudará a garantir que o projeto seja desenvolvido de acordo com as melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Sua habilidade para se comunicar eficazmente com os membros da equipe e os stakeholders do projeto será crucial para manter todos informados sobre o progresso e os desafios enfrentados. Além disso, você colaborará com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e gerentes de projeto para solucionar problemas e encontrar soluções inovadoras.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Analisar e compreender as necessidades e requisitos dos clientes, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com as equipes internas e os stakeholders para implementar soluções técnicas adequadas e inovadoras.
  • Desenvolver e documentar código de alta qualidade, seguindo padrões e melhores práticas de programação, utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas apropriadas para atender aos requisitos do projeto.
  • Participar do processo completo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento e análise até a programação, testes e implantação, garantindo a entrega de soluções funcionais e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e gerentes de projeto, compartilhando conhecimento e ajudando a solucionar problemas e encontrar soluções inovadoras.
  • Comunicar-se efetivamente com os membros da equipe e os stakeholders do projeto, fornecendo atualizações de progresso, discutindo desafios e soluções, e sendo capaz de responder a perguntas e resolver problemas conforme necessário.
  • Participar de revisões de código e reuniões de equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos e práticas de desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do setor e desenvolvimentos tecnológicos, aplicando esse conhecimento no aprimoramento das soluções e na promoção da inovação contínua.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Domínio sólido da linguagem de programação Java, incluindo POO, Generics, Programação Funcional (Lambdas, Streams), exceções, Reflection, testes unitários e ferramentas de build (Maven/Gradle).
  • Experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas Java populares (Spring, JPA (Hibernate), JUnit (4 e 5) e Mockito)
  • Experiência em documentação de APIs usando o padrão OpenAPI ou similares como Swagger, gerados automaticamente através do código da aplicação desenvolvida. É esperado que também consiga elaborar manualmente contratos de APIs usando OpenAPI.
  • Familiaridade com o desenvolvimento de aplicações web, utilizando tecnologias como HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
  • Proatividade na automação de tarefas e otimização de entregas, utilizando scripts, extensões, plugins de IDE e IA de forma responsável .
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server), modelagem de dados, SQL e ORMs como Hibernate.
  • Expertise em práticas e convenções para desenvolvimento de software como SOLID, design patterns, clean code e outras que valorizam melhores práticas.
  • Domínio em versionamento de código usando GIT, bem como resolução de conflitos em merges de branchs.
  • Experiência com a integração de APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, aplicando melhores práticas na elaboração de contratos de comunicação.
  • Experiência com soluções de mensageria (como AWS SQS, RabbitMQ ou similar) ou baseada em eventos (como Kafka, Azure Service Bus, GCP PubSub, AWS SNS ou similares).
  • Experiência com computação em nuvem, incluindo pelo menos um dos principais provedores: AWS (Lambda, S3, SQS, EC2, RDS), Azure (Functions, Blob Storage, Service Bus) ou GCP (Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Firestore).

Você irá se destacar e será considerado diferencial se:

  • Experiência com observabilidade (DataDog, NewRelic, Dynatrace) e implementação de dashboards.
  • Implementação de telemetria com OpenTelemetry.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de resiliência com Resilient4J ou similares.
  • Experiência com gRPC e SSE (Server-Sent Events).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura hexagonal.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mock para APIs REST.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

  • Seguro de vida.

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.

  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.

  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.

Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

  • +7 anos de experiência em TIBCO.
