Se conseguimos chamar a sua atenção, agora esperamos despertar o seu entusiasmo.

Pronto para a primeira fase? Estamos à sua espera!

Para quaisquer questões ou pedidos relacionados com os direitos de proteção de dados pessoais, o titular dos dados poderá contactar a sede da AUBAY PORTUGAL, na Avenida Duque D’Ávila, nº 46, em Lisboa, ou através do e-mail do Encarregado de Proteção de Dados (DPO) –

title: Analista de Atenção a Saúde Pleno
description:
A Unimed BH

Somos a Unimed-BH, uma das melhores operadoras de planos de saúde do Brasil. Há mais de 50 anos, nosso propósito é cuidar da saúde, e esse cuidado se traduz em inovação contínua, qualidade com custo acessível, ética e sustentabilidade para oferecer o melhor serviço aos nossos mais de 1.500.000 de clientes.

O nosso compromisso é proporcionar um ambiente pautado pelo respeito, pelo acolhimento e pela valorização ao nosso time de mais de 10 mil profissionais, entre colaboradores administrativos, assistenciais e médicos cooperados.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência, pessoas de todas as orientações sexuais e identidades de gênero, de diferentes raças e etnias, e idades, sem qualquer tipo de distinção.

Acreditamos que agilidade e simplicidade são a melhor forma de trabalhar e estamos sempre prontos para sugerir novas soluções para serviços e produtos, afinal, a inovação está no nosso DNA, o que nos leva a inspirar nossos colaboradores a atuarmos juntos, como um só time, com foco do cliente.

Para isso, oferecemos um ambiente propício ao desenvolvimento e benefícios atrativos de mercado. Esperamos você para seguirmos juntos cuidando da saúde!

É necessário que tenha:

  • Graduação em Enfermagem;
  • Pós Graduação em Gestão em Saúde, Vigilância Epidemiológica, e afins.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e monitoramento dos modelos de atenção e demais soluções em saúde;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação dos modelos de atenção à saúde para adequação às necessidades do negócio;
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência dos marcos regulatórios da Atenção à Saúde (ANS e PROMOPREV).

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Contribuir no desenvolvimento e monitoramento dos modelos de atenção e demais soluções em saúde aos padrões normativos regulatórios e diretrizes aplicáveis e/ou estabelecidas pela Unimed-BH, por meio do gerenciamento de projetos e aplicação de melhoria de processos.
  • Participar na proposição de métricas e metas de avaliação dos modelos de atenção à saúde para adequação às necessidades do negócio.
  • Contribuir na análise e controle de possíveis mudanças e aumento de escopo dos modelos e serviços em execução, fornecendo subsídio para tomada de decisão;
  • Auxiliar no levantamento de informações, para atendimento às necessidades do negócio.
  • Realizar monitoramento do cenário epidemiológico nacional e internacional por meio do acompanhamento das publicações dos órgãos de referência;
  • Responsável pelo acompanhamento da publicação de notas técnicas, pareces, informes dos órgãos de saúde visando disseminar o conhecimento dentro da Superintendência de Atenção á Saúde e demais áreas da cooperativa;
  • Contribuir e desenvolver conteúdos informativos para fortalecimento da promoção e prevenção da saúde e autocuidado.
  • Apoiar na organização e mapeamento das ações referente a acreditação da operadora, por meio do acompanhamento da adequação dos processos da Atenção à Saúde aos requisitos do Programa de Acreditação das Operadoras da ANS.

Horário e Local de Trabalho:

  • Segunda a Sexta (8h às 18h)
  • Ed. Inconfidentes - Belo Horizonte.

A Unimed-BH respeita a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas vagas. Sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, religião ou deficiência.

Identificou-se com os requisitos? Clique em "Candidatura Simplificada" e faça a sua inscrição! No portal de vagas da Unimed-BH, você encontra essa e outras oportunidades da Cooperativa. Acesse vagas.unimedbh.com.br e faça parte do nosso time.

- Entrevista com o RH e aplicação de ferramenta de autoconhecimento;

Sobre a empresa

Depois de mais de 30 mil alunos na Upinside, resolvemos fundar o Grupo Agência de Valor, uma empresa 100% focada em mentoria para prestadores de serviços digitais, eugências, freelancers e agências que querem estruturar e escalar para 100 mil ou mais todos os meses.

Para isso estruturamos a nossa agência de performance focada em rampar agências digitais. Nosso primeiro desafio? Construir um time de vendas forte, unido, de alta performance e com vontade de ajudar na missão de construir e evoluir esse mercado em nosso país.

Acreditamos no poder que as agências têm em trazer resultados para milhares de negócios no Brasil, movimentando o mercado e transformando centenas de milhares de forma direta e indireta.

Nossa missão é ajudar a estruturar, escalar e ajudar cada uma dessas agências a crescer com mentoria e programa premium de acompanhamento.

title: Data Architect
description:
Do you like to solve complex and high scale data challenges? Do you like to work in a variety of business environments, through high impact projects that use the newest data analytic technologies transitioning to a modern data stack?

  • Data Modeling: Ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
  • ETL Processes: Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes and tools.
  • Experience in Big Data Technologies: Knowledge of big data technologies like SnowFlake, DataBricks, Spark, and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience of cloud based soluions (AWS or Microsoft), system, network and operating system experience
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

This role is a unique opportunity to shape the future of digital platforms at Stellantis and drive innovation in the field of Data Platforms architecture. If you are passionate about technology and eager to lead a team towards success, we encourage you to apply.

"At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. title: Analista Renda Fixa Crédito Privado PL - Asset
description:
Descrição da área

A área de Renda Fixa Crédito Privado, parte do braço de Asset Management do Grupo Daycoval, abrange a carteira de ativos financeiros que constituem títulos de dívida para tomada de recursos junto ao mercado de capitais. Divide-se em duas macros atividades (ou células): a Gestão de Portfólio e a Pesquisa de Crédito (ou Credit Research ).

A célula de Credit Research desempenha, principalmente, a função de analisar os emissores de títulos de dívida acerca de diversos fatores de risco, dentre eles, destacadamente o risco de crédito. Apoia-se em uma política de gerenciamento de risco de crédito própria, que norteia os principais preceitos para a aplicação da análise de risco e demais processos subsequentes, tais como o monitoramento de resultados dos emissores e fluxos avulsos e pontuais (assembleias, pipeline, documentos regulatórios, etc). Assim, esta célula trabalha em conjunto com a parte de Gestão de Portfólio com o objetivo de realizar aquisições de ativos de crédito privado com o devido conhecimento e acompanhamento do risco de crédito.

Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar o mercado de crédito privado, desde o pipeline e o fluxo de notícias até eventos pontuais, como assembleias e comunicados ou fatos relevantes;
  • Avaliar e mensurar o risco de crédito de emissores de crédito privado;
  • Analisar a estrutura dos instrumentos de crédito privado;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento periódico da qualidade de crédito dos emissores por meio de monitoramentos de resultados;
  • Conduzir avaliações de aspectos ambientais, sociais e de governança (ESG) sobre os emissores.

Qualificações

  • Conhecimento sólido em contabilidade, finanças e mercados de crédito;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados, como Excel VBA, plataformas da CVM e Economatica;
  • Fluência em modelagem financeira (Fluxo de Caixa Descontado – DCF, Previsão de Insolvência, Análise de Pares);
  • Certificações em Research ou Gestão, como CNPI, CGA ou CGE.

  • Experiência prévia, preferencialmente, em Credit Research, em gestoras de recursos (Asset Management) ou em DCM (Debt Capital Markets);
  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Mínimo de dois anos de experiência em Asset ou DCM, e três anos ou mais em Equity Research, Agência de Rating ou áreas de Risco de Crédito em instituições financeiras.

Competências

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Inglês em nível intermediário;
  • Facilidade na elaboração de materiais e relatórios executivos (PowerPoint e ferramentas similares);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e senso de organização.

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.

  • Programa de Participação de Resultados: Incentivo contínuo para o alcance de metas individuais e coletivas.

title: ANALISTA DE MARKET PRICING JÚNIOR - AUTOMÓVEL
description:

O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento nas áreas de Economia, Estatística, Atuária, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Matemática ou afins.

  • Perfil analítico, estratégico e colaborativo, com capacidade de transformar dados em decisões.

DIFERENCIAIS QUE CONTAM MUITO (Não eliminatórios):

Manipulação de bases de dados (SQL, Python e/ou SAS);

O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR:

A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.

title: Senior Power BI Developer / Architect
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Power BI Developer / Architect to take full ownership of our Power BI environment. This person will be the go-to expert for everything related to Power BI: embedded reporting, performance optimization, deployment, visualization best practices, and governance.

The ideal candidate is hands-on, deeply technical, and passionate about delivering high-performing, visually polished analytics experiences. You won’t be responsible for data modeling or ETL work — the datasets will be prepared for you — but you will be responsible for turning them into dynamic, reliable, and impactful Power BI experiences that scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all aspects of Power BI administration and development , ensuring performance, security, and reliability.
  • Manage Power BI embedded reports , including integration with web applications and internal tools.
  • Configure and maintain Power BI deployment pipelines for smooth promotion across environments.
  • Perform performance tuning and optimization across reports, datasets, and DAX queries.
  • Customize and enhance visuals using Deneb and other advanced visualization techniques.
  • Edit and maintain JSON files for Deneb configurations and advanced Power BI customizations.
  • Manage report access, permissions, and workspace organization.
  • Partner with business and product teams to ensure reports are clear, actionable, and visually aligned with company standards.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Power BI development and administration .
  • Proven experience with Power BI Embedded , deployment pipelines , and workspace management .
  • Strong ability to optimize report performance and troubleshoot complex Power BI issues.
  • Experience editing JSON files for configuration and visualization customization.
  • Strong knowledge of DAX and Power BI internals.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Deneb for custom visual storytelling.
  • Expertise using background images and layout design for highly customized report visuals.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps or other CI/CD tools for Power BI automation.
  • Experience creating embedded analytics for client-facing products or portals.

Why Developros

At Developros , we connect top-tier, timezone-aligned technical professionals with leading U.S. companies. You’ll collaborate with teams that value ownership, clarity, and craftsmanship. Our focus is on building long-term partnerships with professionals who elevate the people and products they work with.

About Uitify

Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Senior Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Senior experience: 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);

  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil a ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

O Grupo Capital:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial:

title: Operations Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.

We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

As Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo’s battery swapping network — the heart of our customer experience. You will oversee 24/7 operations across hundreds of swap stations, leading teams that keep our infrastructure, field logistics, and data systems running at scale. This is not a back-office role: it’s hands-on, mission-critical, and fundamental to shaping how Latin America moves.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and guide our LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure teams, building a culture of urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Map, design, and scale operational processes to reduce costs, increase efficiency, and prepare for 10x growth.
  • Be responsible for the network’s uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Define and track core KPIs (uptime, SLAs, maintenance cost, SOC, CSAT) using dashboards and data analysis.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the operational voice for Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback for hardware and software design.
  • Guide network expansion decisions (site selection, installation, and launch playbooks).
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, lead post-mortems, and prevent recurrence.

Requirements

  • +5-8 years experience in managing physical operations, field services, logistics, or technical infrastructure,
  • Strong people leadership; ability to motivate diverse, field-based teams.
  • Data-driven decision-making, with experience using analytics tools (Metabase, Tableau, etc.).
  • Skill in process design, optimization, and creation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Ability to solve problems calmly and decisively under pressure.
  • Pragmatic “owner” mindset (extreme ownership) — equally comfortable in the field and in strategic discussions.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to align technology teams, executives, and field personnel.
  • Technical curiosity — an engineer or operator at heart — with a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data really work.

Bonus Points if You Have:

  • Experience in high-growth startups.
  • Background in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications.
  • Experience managing 24/7 mission-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware operations, maintenance cycles, or supply chain management.
  • Basic SQL knowledge for independent analysis.

Benefits

  • Manage a vital area in a fast-growing startup transforming the future of mobility in Latin America, backed by top-tier venture capital investors.
  • Opportunity to work in a mission-driven company — reducing carbon emissions and empowering underserved populations.
  • Be part of a talented, ambitious, and collaborative team that’s building something big.
  • Autonomy and freedom to take on high-impact responsibilities and grow fast.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Equity participation — the opportunity to own a piece of the company.
  • Health insurance.

title: ASSISTENTE SERVIÇOS E CONSERVAÇÃO
description:
Sobre a GRU Airport

A GRU Airport , conhecido como o maior aeroporto do Brasil, conecta sonhos, destinos e oportunidades há quase quatro décadas.

Reconhecido como o principal hub da América Latina, a GRU Airport , administradora do Aeroporto Internacional de São Paulo, em Guarulhos, é referência em eficiência e conectividade. Porta de entrada do Brasil para o mundo.

Nossa infraestrutura e nossos serviços garantem uma operação contínua, segura e de qualidade, atendendo às necessidades de passageiros e empresas. Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza a inovação, o desenvolvimento e o impacto positivo na jornada de cada viajante, venha construir o futuro conosco no setor da aviação.

Na GRU, acreditamos que cada colaborador é fundamental para alcançar novos patamares.

DESCRIÇÃO:

Apoiar a supervisão da limpeza geral do aeroporto e dos sanitários, garantindo a execução das rotinas conforme padrão. Atua como suporte operacional nas vistorias diárias dos terminais, contribuindo para a manutenção do Fator Q e para a melhor experiência de passageiros, visitantes e colaboradores.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Acompanhamento de Rotinas: Auxiliar na fiscalização da limpeza geral e sanitária em terminais, áreas administrativas e externas, registrando conformidades e não conformidades.
  • Verificação de Padrões: Conferir a frequência e a qualidade da limpeza, garantindo a aderência aos critérios definidos e reportando irregularidades à supervisão.
  • Suporte à Gestão de Terceiros: Apoiar o controle de presença, distribuição de equipes e uso adequado de materiais e EPIs da empresa contratada.
  • Relatórios e Indicadores: Preencher checklists e relatórios de vistoria, fornecendo dados para análise de indicadores de desempenho e Fator Q.
  • Interface Operacional: Servir de ponto de apoio entre a equipe de limpeza, a supervisão e outras áreas operacionais, comunicando demandas e ocorrências em tempo real.
  • Apoio em Planejamento: Colaborar no ajuste de escalas e no direcionamento de reforços de limpeza conforme o fluxo de passageiros e eventos extraordinários.

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS

FORMAÇÃO/ EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Ensino médio completo; desejável curso técnico ou superior em andamento em Administração, Hotelaria, Gestão de Facilites ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência anterior em conservação e limpeza ou em ambientes de grande circulação (aeroporto, shopping, hospital, hotelaria) será um diferencial.

CONHECIMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS / HABILIDADES

  • Pacote Office básico a intermediário.
  • Atenção a detalhes e olhar crítico para padrões de limpeza.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Organização, proatividade e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
  • Senso de urgência e foco em resultados.

PACOTE ATRATIVOS

⏰ Disponibilidade para Escala de trabalho;

Salário Compatível com o Mercado;

️ Vale Refeição: R$ 1255,78 mês;

title: Coordenador de infraestrutura de Redes
description:
Vaga: Coordenador de Infraestrutura de Redes

Descrição:

Buscamos um profissional para coordenar a infraestrutura de redes em nossa organização. O Coordenador de Infraestrutura de Redes será responsável pelo planejamento, implementação, manutenção e monitoramento das redes corporativas, garantindo segurança, performance e alta disponibilidade. Este profissional atuará diretamente com a equipe técnica e com outros departamentos, assegurando a continuidade dos serviços e a conformidade com as políticas internas e externas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Planejamento e Arquitetura de Redes: Revisão e implementação de soluções para redes corporativas.
  • Gerenciamento de Desempenho e Disponibilidade: Garantir alta performance e confiabilidade da infraestrutura de redes.
  • Suporte Técnico: Gerenciamento de incidentes, resolução de problemas e implementação de soluções preventivas.
  • Compliance e Auditorias: Garantir conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentos externos.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Redes: Experiência com dispositivos como switches, roteadores, firewalls e ferramentas de monitoramento (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds).
  • Infraestrutura de TI: Conhecimentos em LAN, WAN, VPNs, servidores e armazenamento.
  • Segurança de Redes: Implementação de medidas de segurança (firewalls, criptografia, VPN, controle de acesso).
  • Cloud e Virtualização: Experiência com virtualização de redes (SDN, NFV) e integração com AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud.

Competências de Gestão:

  • Liderança: Coordenação de equipes técnicas, delegação de tarefas e desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Planejamento e execução de projetos de infraestrutura de rede.
  • Gestão de Conflitos: Habilidade em resolver conflitos e manter o ambiente produtivo.

Formação e Certificações:

  • Graduação em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Redes ou afins.
  • Certificações como CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, CISSP, CISM ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect.

Vivência:

  • Vivência Consolidada em infraestrutura de TI, com experiência em redes de médio e grande porte.
  • Vivência em gestão de equipes e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

Habilidades Interpessoais:

  • Comunicação: Capacidade de explicar questões técnicas para equipes não técnicas e gerenciar relatórios executivos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Colaboração com outros departamentos para entender necessidades e fornecer soluções adequadas.

title: Tech Lead (Conversational Solutions)
description:
Sinch is at the forefront of transforming customer communications, offering innovative solutions that empower businesses around the globe. We are looking for a Tech Lead specializing in Conversational Solutions to guide our talented engineers and help shape our cutting-edge platforms.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our conversational AI solutions, integrating advanced technologies such as NLP and machine learning to deliver exceptional user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of conversational solutions, including chatbots and voice initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Architect and design scalable systems that can handle real-time interactions and integrate various channels of communication.
  • Guide and mentor a team of engineers, promoting best practices and innovation in software development.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality products.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in conversational AI and incorporate relevant advancements into Sinch's offerings.
  • Ensure robust testing and deployment processes, maintaining high standards of code quality and system reliability.
  • Actively contribute to the team's success by driving initiatives, providing technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment.

Requirements

  • Experience performing as technical lead of Software Development team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving collaborative projects.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.

Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.

  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Senior Sourcer - Talent Mapping
description:

title: Solutions Consultant - LATAM
description:

Embarking on a career at Netcore transcends a typical job – it's an opportunity to shape the future of MarTech. For further information, we invite you to visit netcorecloud.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

title: SAP Cutover Lead
description:
Senior SAP Cutover Lead

Location: Remote – Brazil

Experience: 10+ Years

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP Cutover Lead to plan, manage, and execute cutover activities across complex SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA, RISE, and cloud-based migrations . The ideal candidate will be responsible for orchestrating all phases of the technical and business cutover, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring a smooth transition from legacy to target systems with minimal disruption to operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the end-to-end cutover strategy , timeline, and execution plan for SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Coordinate with functional, technical, BASIS, infrastructure, and business process teams to define cutover tasks, dependencies, and sequencing.
  • Drive the development of cutover checklists, runbooks, and readiness assessments .
  • Conduct mock cutovers and rehearsals to validate timing, resources, and risk mitigation.
  • Monitor and report progress during each phase of the cutover cycle; manage go/no-go checkpoints.
  • Identify and proactively resolve cutover issues and risks to maintain go-live stability.
  • Collaborate with project management, business owners, and system integrators to ensure alignment with overall deployment milestones.
  • Facilitate post-cutover reviews, stabilization planning, and transition to support teams.
  • Maintain detailed documentation and ensure compliance with change control and audit standards.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of SAP experience, with 5+ years leading cutover planning and execution for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or RISE programs.
  • Proven track record managing large-scale, multi-stream cutovers involving multiple systems and geographies.
  • Strong understanding of SAP technical architecture, BASIS operations, and infrastructure dependencies.
  • Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills—capable of working with distributed global teams.
  • Hands-on experience with cutover management tools (e.g., SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager, MS Project, Jira, or Smartsheet).
  • Ability to anticipate risks and design effective fallback and recovery plans.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills with a proactive, detail-oriented approach.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP RISE migrations, Greenfield/Brownfield implementations , and system consolidations .
  • Familiarity with cloud hosting (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and hybrid landscape cutovers.
  • Certification in SAP Activate or PMP/Prince2 project management.

Why Join Us

  • Lead mission-critical cutovers across global SAP programs.
  • Collaborate with seasoned SAP professionals across functional and technical domains.
  • Remote flexibility with opportunities for long-term global project exposure.

title: Especialista de Arquiteto de Soluções
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!

Sobre a área: Descreva informações complementares sobre a área caso necessário.

Principais atividades:Avaliar a arquitetura atual, identificar necessidades de integração e projetar novas soluções.

Desenvolver modelos de arquitetura: Criar diagramas e documentação para descrever como os sistemas se interconectam e como a solução será implementada.

Escolher tecnologias: Selecionar as ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para a integração, considerando fatores como desempenho, segurança e escalabilidade.

Implementar e testar soluções: Participar da implementação das soluções de integração e garantir que elas funcionem corretamente e de forma segura.

Manter e otimizar a integração: Monitorar o desempenho das integrações, identificar gargalos e implementar melhorias.

Documentar a arquitetura de integração: Criar documentação detalhada sobre a arquitetura, os padrões e as políticas de software.

Colaborar com outras áreas: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras equipes, como desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura e segurança da informação, para garantir entrega eficiente da solução.

Manter-se atualizado: Acompanhar as tendências e tecnologias de integração, buscando soluções e abordagens mais eficazes.

Buscamos alguém que apresente: Ensino superior completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.

Experiência de trabalho comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções ou função similar.

Experiência em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de sistemas.

Inglês intermediário ou fluente.

Conhecimentos em arquitetura de software: Capacidade de compreender e projetar sistemas complexos.

Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem: usando Kubernetes e Openshift para eficiência e escalabilidade dos serviços.

Conhecimentos em segurança: Capacidade de projetar e implementar soluções de integração que sejam seguras e protegidas.

Conhecimento técnico: Sólidos conhecimentos em várias linguagens de programação, sistemas operacionais e bancos de dados.

Conhecimento de tecnologias de integração: Familiaridade com ferramentas e tecnologias de integração, como plataformas de integração de aplicativos (APIs), plataformas de integração de eventos (ESBs) como Kafka e RabbitMQ e de ferramentas de ETL.

Conhecimento de ferramentas de IA, Devops, CI/CD, monitoramento.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

Other Requirements

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking , exceptional communication, and proven ability to operate with high autonomy and strong results-orientation.

title: Senior Graphic Artist
description:

Design and visual communication play a crucial role in how Kore communicates innovation, trust, and leadership in fintech and compliance-driven markets. Every visual asset — from investor materials to digital campaigns — must reflect our precision, sophistication, and purpose.

This role combines brand leadership, creative design, and AI-assisted innovation to ensure Kore’s identity remains consistent, compelling, and globally recognized.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and working closely with the VP Technology , Product , and Client Success teams, the Graphic Artist will manage the visual direction for Kore’s platforms and campaigns, ensuring all creative materials align with brand standards and business goals.

The Graphic Artist will also mentor and manage a junior designer , fostering a creative environment that balances speed, quality, and design excellence.

  • Develop and maintain Kore’s brand identity system , ensuring consistent application across Kore’s subsidiaries and platforms.
  • Produce visual assets for all Kore divisions — Kore, KoreTransfer, KoreChain, KoreWire, KoreID, KoreGPT, Kore Issuance, Kore Platform, KoreClearing, and KoreSummit .
  • Create and maintain brand style guides , color systems, typography standards, and layout frameworks.
  • Partner with the CMO and senior leadership to evolve Kore’s visual storytelling across all touchpoints.
2. Marketing & Corporate Design
  • Design marketing materials including brochures, fact sheets, corporate reports, whitepapers, and investor decks.
  • Create infographics, charts, and diagrams to communicate complex fintech concepts clearly and visually.
  • Develop digital and social media assets for marketing campaigns, press releases, and events.
  • Design presentation templates and visual systems for Kore executives and partner-facing communications.
  • Support KoreSummit with event branding, stage visuals, signage, and multimedia content.
3. Web, Product, and UX Collaboration
  • Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to produce UX/UI assets in Figma and Adobe XD.

  • Support the development of KoreWire and KorePlatform’s front-end experience with responsive visuals and layout guidance.

  • Comunicação: Excelente habilidade para se comunicar de forma clara e objetiva com diferentes públicos, desde equipes técnicas até a alta diretoria. Atua como uma ponte entre os stakeholders.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!

Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).

Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

title: Power BI Developer
description:

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

As a Software Accounting Trainer / Onboarding Specialist, you’ll play a key role in guiding new clients in the vacation rental industry through their onboarding process. You’ll ensure proper setup of taxes, fees, and trust accounting, and train clients on how to use the software system effectively to stay compliant and confident. This role blends accounting expertise with training, customer service, and problem-solving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding and transition sessions for new vacation rental clients, ensuring accurate accounting system setup.
  • Train clients via Zoom on all accounting functions within the system, including trust accounting.
  • Perform and review accounting tasks such as:
  • Bank and non-bank account reconciliations
  • Entering transactions and journal entries
  • Preparing Trial Balance and Trust reports
  • Reviewing client entries for errors and developing correction plans
  • Identify misplaced or invalid data, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolution.
  • Respond to support tickets and client calls promptly, providing clear, professional guidance.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through exceptional customer service.
  • Write and update knowledge base articles to support client and internal education.
  • Lead webinars and group training sessions for clients and staff on accounting best practices.
  • Document and analyze client questions and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Collaborate with instructional design and internal teams to create and improve training resources.
  • Participate in team meetings and internal projects, contributing to process improvements and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2–5 years of accounting or bookkeeping experience, preferably in property management or vacation rental industries.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles; trust accounting knowledge highly preferred.
  • Experience with accounting for vacation rentals, property management, or hospitality a strong plus.
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, and video conferencing tools (Zoom or equivalent).
  • Proven success in delivering excellent customer service.
  • Ability to communicate complex accounting concepts clearly to clients and colleagues.
  • Strong organizational skills, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Professional, polished, and engaging personality with an approachable teaching style.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment; quick learner and adaptable team player.

Why Join Us?

This role is ideal for accounting professionals who want to apply their technical expertise in a more dynamic, client-facing role. You’ll directly support vacation rental property managers by helping them master their accounting systems, stay in trust, and operate with confidence. At the same time, you’ll build skills in training, client success, and process improvement while working in one of the fastest-growing segments of the hospitality industry.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At MTech Systems, our company mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population without compromising animal welfare or damaging the planet. We aim to create software that delivers real-time data to the entire supply chain that allows producers to get better insight into what is happening on their farms and what they can do to responsibly improve production.

MTech Systems is a prominent provider of tools for managing performance in Live Animal Protein Production. For over 30 years, MTech Systems has provided cutting-edge enterprise data solutions for all aspects of the live poultry operations cycle. We provide our customers with solutions in Business Intelligence, Live Production Accounting, Production Planning, and Remote Data Management—all through an integrated system. Our applications can currently be found running businesses on six continents in over 50 countries. MTech has built an international reputation for equipping our customers with the power to utilize comprehensive data to maximize profitability.

With over 275 employees globally, MTech Systems currently has main offices in Mexico, United States, and Brazil, with additional resources in key markets around the world. MTech Systems USA’s headquarters is based in Atlanta, Georgia and has approximately 90 team members in a casual, collaborative environment. Our work culture here is based on a commitment to helping our clients feed the world, resulting in a flexible and rewarding atmosphere. We are committed to maintaining a work culture that enhances collaboration, provides robust development tools, offers training programs, and allows for direct access to senior and executive management.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong customer-facing experience to join our IT team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cloud architecture, automation, and customer success. You’ll work closely with internal teams and external customers to design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure—primarily in Microsoft Azure.

You’ll play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, supporting SaaS deployments, and ensuring our customers have seamless experience with our cloud-hosted solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong emphasis on communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure to support customer-facing applications.
  • Collaborate with product, development, and customer success teams to ensure infrastructure meets customer needs and SLAs.
  • Lead cloud onboarding and deployment efforts for new customers, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security configuration.
  • Optimize cloud costs and performance through proactive analysis and automation.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on cloud best practices, security, and architecture.
  • Document infrastructure designs, runbooks, and customer-specific configurations.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for cloud-related issues and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing or consulting role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Azure, including Azure AD, networking, storage, and compute services.
  • Must be proficient in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments and legacy system integration.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding, technical account management, or solution architecture.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

title: Diretor de Saúde e Segurança - Operações da América do Sul/Director, Health & Safety - South American Operations
description:
O Diretor Regional de Saúde e Segurança (Operações da América do Sul) é responsável por liderar e supervisionar a função de saúde e segurança em todos as operações e projetos na América do Sul. Essa função garante a implementação efetiva da estratégia corporativa de saúde e segurança, impulsiona a melhoria contínua e promove uma cultura de segurança proativa alinhada com o compromisso da Pan American Silver em fazer " Segurança de forma Diferente ". O Diretor Regional trabalha em estreita colaboração com a liderança do local, as equipes corporativas de saúde e segurança e as equipes de projeto para prevenir ferimentos graves e fatalidades, garantir a conformidade regulatória e promover as melhores práticas.

Linha de relatório

  • Reporta-se a: Vice-Presidente de Saúde e Segurança
  • Localização: Residência na América do Sul necessária.
  • Viagens: 30-40% anualmente para locais de operação e desenvolvimento, muitas vezes em grandes altitudes ou regiões remotas da América do Sul
  • Reporte: Líderes de Saúde e Segurança das Operações/Projetos (Pontilhado/Matricial)

Principais responsabilidades

  • Implementar e supervisionar a estratégia corporativa de saúde e segurança em todos os sites da América do Sul, com foco no gerenciamento de riscos críticos e prevenção de lesões graves e fatalidades: SIF (CRM, FIT/HOP, etc.)
  • Atuar como o principal elo de ligação entre a liderança das operações/projetos e o departamento corporativo de saúde e segurança.
  • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver equipes de saúde e segurança no local, garantindo a execução eficaz de programas de gerenciamento de segurança e planos de ação
  • Colaborar com a liderança do local e do projeto para identificar, planejar e executar projetos de melhoria técnica e metas anuais de saúde e segurança
  • Garantir que planos robustos de resposta a emergências e sistemas de preparação estejam em vigor e sejam testados regularmente
  • Monitorar o cumprimento da legislação, diretrizes e políticas de saúde e segurança da empresa; comunicar atualizações e garantir a implementação de novos requisitos
  • Incentivar a comunicação e o compartilhamento de lições aprendidas com incidentes e eventos de alto potencial em todos os locais
  • Promover uma cultura de segurança como um valor fundamental, envolvendo as partes interessadas em todos os níveis e servindo como um líder visível na região.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a resposta à gestão de crises em nível regional
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios, métricas e recomendações de desempenho de segurança para líderes regionais e corporativos, incluindo relatórios mensais e trimestrais

Habilidades e experiência necessárias

  • 10+ anos de experiência em cargos de liderança em saúde e segurança na indústria de mineração, incluindo operações de sites na América Latina
  • Experiência comprovada na implementação de sistemas de gestão de segurança e garantia da conformidade com os padrões internacionais e locais de saúde e segurança
  • Experiência avançada em análise de risco, investigação de incidentes (i.e. ICAM) e implementação da Gestão de Controles Críticos (i.e. FRM, CRM, etc)
  • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas, gerenciamento de projetos e organização
  • Bacharelado em Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, Engenharia ou disciplina relacionada (Segurança Industrial, Ciências Ambientais, Engenharia de Minas, Geociências, Ciências Sociais)
  • É preferível um mestrado ou qualificação de pós-graduação relevante
  • É necessária fluência em espanhol e inglês, é desejável proficiência em português

Competências-chave

  • Experiência em ambientes multiculturais; É necessária experiência atual ou anterior de trabalho em países da América Latina
  • Proficiência na criação de materiais atraentes para partes interessadas internas e externas
  • Liderança inspiradora e capacidade de motivar equipes multifuncionais
  • Mentalidade estratégica focada na melhoria contínua e excelência operacional
  • Habilidades eficazes de comunicação e apresentação, capazes de interagir com as equipes do local e a alta administração
  • Capacidade de traduzir questões gerais de segurança em planos regionais acionáveis

Outros requisitos

  • Disposição e capacidade de viajar para locais de operações e desenvolvimento, muitas vezes em grandes altitudes e/ou em regiões remotas da América do Sul
  • Deverá residir na América do Sul

-

The Director, Health & Safety – South American Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing the health and safety function across all mining sites and projects in our South American Operations region. This role ensures the effective implementation of corporate health and safety strategy, drives continuous improvement, and fosters a proactive safety culture aligned with Pan American Silver’s commitment to “Doing Safety Differently”. The Director collaborates closely with site leadership, Corporate health and safety (H&S), and project teams to prevent serious injuries and fatalities - SIFs, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote best practices.

Reports to: Vice President, Health & Safety.

Location: Residence in South America is required.

Travel: 30–40% annually to operating and development sites, often at high altitudes or remote regions in South America.

Direct Reports: Site Health and Safety Leaders (dotted line/matrix org.).

Major Responsibilities:

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Why choose us?

Page Outsourcing is one of the fastest growing Global Outsourced providers, having more than doubled its headcount in the past 18 months to support major clients across UK, North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America. This unprecedented expansion is due to our unique positioning within the global outsourcing industry and our ability to offer tailored, multi-regional outsourcing solutions, across the full total talent spectrum. Underpinned by our best-in-class Page Group infrastructure, we have an unmatched opportunity to deliver industry-leading performance.

What will you be doing?

You’ll be working, embedded in our client’s team, utilising their systems to deliver best-in-class hiring outcomes across a wider program or part of their business. You will own the recruitment strategy and be responsible for development, leadership and oversight of a team of recruiters supporting the client. You will demonstrate the ability to prioritise and manage your own workload in addition to supporting the team of recruiters you will be responsible for leading and developing. You'll be tasked with building and managing excellent relationships with hiring managers, maximising contract performance, while achieving all aspects of the service level agreement. You’ll work with our clients, helping to deliver their workforce plans, delivering outstanding experiences in line with the Page Outsourcing Values.

Key Activities

  • Build and maintain excellent working relationships with all client hiring managers and departments to ensure a smooth and timely recruitment process
  • Liaise with on-site contacts to understand and qualify hiring requirements
  • To generate and effectively manage candidate applications, ensuring a positive candidate experience
  • Innovative use of sourcing tools maximising applications and efficient screening of all applicants as we shortlist.
  • Negotiate starter offers and arrange related paperwork
  • Lead team to deliver on recruitment process and support (e.g. scheduling, compliance, governance, etc.)
  • Leadership, coaching and management of Recruiters and supporting Talent Sourcing partners and Talent Sourcing Co-Ordinators (onsite or remote)
  • Align on hiring strategies and best practices to ensure successful hiring outcomes
  • Effective use of reporting to develop and track the performance of the team in support of the client
  • Ensure full compliance of all data entered into the database, and ensure candidate MI is kept current and correct to allow for Market Intel reporting
  • Comply fully with all company procedures, processes, and policies
  • Partner with business leaders to understand business goals
  • Ensure SOP guides are being utilised and team members are in compliance
  • Onboarding of new team members, training and introduction to the resource library

What are we looking for?

  • Proven experience managing high-volume recruitment or sourcing projects, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years’ experience in a people management role, leading a team of 5–10 or more recruiters/sourcers.
  • Strong background in Manufacturing, Chemical, or Oil & Gas (O&G) sectors, with proven expertise in managing talent acquisition or account delivery within these industries.
  • Experience supporting recruitment or account delivery across multiple countries , including Brazil and other international markets.
  • Fluent in English
  • Demonstrable track record in agency and/or onsite recruitment, preferably within the manufacturing and chemical sector

Interlocução com áreas internas: manter contato com equipes de engenharia, sinistros, subscrição e eventualmente clientes, garantindo alinhamento.
